test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 30 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'between'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given blank needs a **preposition **to show the who are the people involved in the contract. 
 
• Let us look into the usage of the given options as prepositions - 
 
 
• **as - **We use as with a noun to refer to the role or purpose of a person or thing: *I worked **as **a waiter when I was a student.*
 
• **between - **We use between when referring to one-to-one relationships. *An agreement was made **between **the trade union and the company. *
 
• **before - **We use before to mean earlier than the time or event mentioned: *Can you call me back **before **5 pm, please?*
 
• **beside - **We use beside to mean "close to" or "next to." - *The shop is **beside **the temple.*
 
 
 
• From the above it is clear that **between **is the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
 
• Hence, **option 2 **is the correct answer.

**Complete passage__ - ***The contract (1) __**between**__** **the author and the reader is a game. And the game is one of the greatest inventions (2) __**of**__** **Western civilisation: the game of telling stories, inventing characters and creating the (3) __**imaginary**__** **paradise of the individual, from whence no one can be expelled (4) __**because**__, in a novel, no one owns the truth and everyone has the right to be (5) **__heard__ **and understood.*
